subtitle: A 387-meter cast-iron pier built in 1862 for Kerala's coir trade, now closed to shipping since 1989 and slated for a modern replacement.
spike_statement: A cast-iron pier built in 1862 to load coir cargo has had no port operations since 1989, Kerala's own port authority says, and sits waiting for a replacement.

levers.photo_tone: Flat monsoon-grey Arabian Sea light, the pier's black cast-iron pilings cutting a stark line into a hazy grey-green horizon
